reason: An HTTP/API debugging toolkit for sending and inspecting REST requests, parsing or executing curl commands, and comparing in-session responses, with an optional request visualization UI.

summaries.zh: 用于发送和检查 REST/HTTP 请求、解析或执行 curl 命令并比较会话内响应的 API 调试工具集。
summaries.en: An API debugging toolkit for sending and inspecting REST/HTTP requests, parsing or executing curl commands, and comparing responses within a session.

capabilities: Sends HTTP requests to configured URLs using common methods
Parses curl commands and can execute them
Supports custom headers, request bodies, and basic or bearer authentication
Records in-session request history and compares responses
Provides optional UI cards for request and response inspection
